changelog: v0.3.9: Meta Quest 3 zero-hang architecture & smart AI engine routing: 1) Added checkWebGPUSupport() with 2.5s adapter probe to detect disabled WebGPU on Quest Browser before invoking WebLLM; 2) Meta Quest 3 detection with proactive Gemini Cloud recommendations in Settings and VR HUD; 3) Shared initialization Promise and listener broadcasting in local.js to eliminate concurrency deadlocks; 4) Built-in conversational fallback for companion queries ('what is your name', 'who are you', etc.) ensuring instant spoken response even when WebGPU is unavailable; 5) Strict 10-12s watchdog with seamless Gemini cloud failover guaranteeing pipeline never hangs on Analyzing.
